    Profile

    Leoniaz is a female knight who is known in Envylia as the "pure white lion". She considers it her duty to act the joker around the ever-serious Lucretia in order to deflate the tension. Her elegant appearance and bravery have won her many female fans, and she is often showered with the shrieks and cries of her supporters.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 168cm
    Weight: 52kg
    Birthday: Aug 1
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: Lollipops
    Hobbies: Training/Practicing with Lucretia
    Illust: ─
    CV: すずきももこ
